existingData.meaning: Existing pilot, failed attempt, lossless feasibility outputs/raw RGB spools, current working tree and current LFS objects are already reflected in freeBytes. Preserve them; do not subtract them again.

copyPolicy.futurePacketDestination: assets/renders/review/characters/<new-unit> (all packet files are LFS under current .gitattributes)
copyPolicy.packetIncludes: Lossless primary media, PNG stills, every complete raw observation, all indices/hash manifests/receipts, contact sheets and selected integration-test evidence
copyPolicy.privateArchives: Preserve owned-job cache/profile/raw-log archives separately in the private unit namespace, indexed by exact paths/hashes. They are not silently deleted and are not duplicated into the Git packet in these cases. If copied into the packet, their bytes also acquire the packet copy multiplier.
copyPolicy.sharedMainHydration: Main and the task worktree share one LFS object database but retain two working-tree copies after merge hydration. Add a packet copy for main.
copyPolicy.independentClone: An independent local clone retains another LFS object database and working-tree copy. Git metadata reserve also applies to the second database.
copyPolicy.avoidableDuplication: A reviewed future capture could write new primary output directly into a new task-worktree packet namespace, avoiding a separate private-primary copy. This is not implemented or authorized and does not move/delete any existing packet.
copyPolicy.gitRepackLimit: Git reserves cover only bounded new source/pointer/tree/commit data and their temporary packing. An unscoped automatic GC/repack of the existing repository is not included and must be excluded from a unit window or separately budgeted.
copyPolicy.gitReserveConditions: Reserve includes bounded new source/code, pointers/trees/commits, both existing worktree-index increments and index-lock/temporary pack files. Future packet tracked-file counts must be bounded. No unscoped GC/repack of the existing repository is assumed.
copyPolicy.independentCloneBaseline: Independent-clone figures count incremental copies of this future packet only. Hydrating any other existing repository/LFS contents into a new clone has an additional, currently unqualified baseline and cannot be admitted from these figures.

contracts.preserve: Complete existing observation fields and original bytes; no dropping/abbreviating poses, identities, errors or unknown metadata. No quality, rate or order change.
contracts.motionByteQuota: 8MiB+160KiB per declared frame is only a proposed enforced lossless quota, not a proven natural codec maximum or a full-completion promise.

fullRemaining.layout: 120 clip-by-people units, each with2 LOD motion captures,1 still capture and2 post-release validator jobs
fullRemaining.archiveMeaning: Keep the accepted1GiB owned-archive allowance for each of600 proposed jobs. Actual archives may be much smaller; no unreviewed global2GiB cache cap is assumed. New validator job details and bounds still need review.
fullRemaining.conclusion: Even one media-plus-complete-observation copy exceeds current free disk before indices, archives or any Git/LFS copy. Lossless motion feasibility does not establish whole-packet or whole-library fit.

smallUnit.newIntegrationFixture: One new output using at most132 existing pilot frames, with512MiB encoded-file ceiling and32MiB complete hash/metadata allowance. Original pilot PNG inputs are read in place, not copied. Existing feasibility files are not charged again.
smallUnit.partialProgressOnly: Admission of this one unit does not promise retention of all remaining units. Preserve every accepted or failed unit and recompute free disk before the next one.
smallUnit.validationFixtureNote: The existing feasibility raw RGB files stay preserved in baseline used space. New integration tests read existing PNG/observation inputs in place and use framehash validation; no new full raw RGB spool is allowed. The512MiB+32MiB fixture allowance is incremental new encoded output and complete test hashes/metadata, not a second charge for old inputs.

decoderPolicy.verification: Use software decoder framehash output and compare ordered RGB/RGBA hashes and exact count/timebase against the captured source manifest. Stream hash calculation; do not persist a full raw RGB reel. Current raw feasibility proof files remain preserved and already occupy baseline disk.

losslessObservationCompressionProposal.format: Per-reel tar+gzip (or a separately reviewed equivalent), with exact original observation JSON bytes as archive members, plus an index of original work ID/path/byte length/SHA256.
losslessObservationCompressionProposal.proofBeforeCredit: A bounded CPU-only test on existing observations must decompress every member and prove byte equality, exact count/order and all unknown fields. Bound archive input/output/memory, reject duplicate/unsafe paths, and preserve all current JSON files.
losslessObservationCompressionProposal.retentionCondition: Savings require a reviewed future contract with the compressed archive as the authoritative complete observation store. Keeping raw JSON plus a compressed copy does not save storage. No current raw observation may be deleted.

unresolvedLimits: Streaming encoder, alpha gating, memory/backpressure and decoder admission are not implemented
No natural whole-library lossless video maximum is proved; quota overflow must HOLD without quality degradation
Index and Git metadata reserves require bounded file counts and no unscoped repository repack
Any archive-retention-cap reduction or metadata compression needs a separate measured/reviewed contract
Current free disk changes during T13; these are timestamped snapshots, not reservations
If preserving original PNG data-URL byte recoverability remains mandatory, pixel-lossless video alone cannot replace those PNG bytes; the image representation contract must be explicit
